The increase in ROCE of 24.1% over the last year (from [E30]) indicates sustained growth in profitability despite the recent decline. This suggests that Veedol Corporation Ltd may be adjusting its operations to maintain or improve its efficiency, which could be a strategic move rather than an indication of underlying issues. Conceded: [E78]
